# Channel scoreboard — per-channel, per-work-class track record

Feeds routing decisions (delegation-protocol R5) and the harness `priors` hook.
Score = verifier score in [0,1]. Update at every task close-out. Retirements
(w≥3 failures on a class) recorded in the notes column with date + reason.

| Channel | Work class | Attempts | Mean | Recent scores (new→old) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secuura agent | money-class infra provisioning (s48, Kintsugi Stage B) | 1 | 1.00 | 1.0 | **08-19 (~25 min) — KINTSUGI PROVISIONED AND VERIFIED: secuura02-kintsugi.southeastasia.cloudapp.azure.com → 20.198.226.148, D2ps_v6 zone 1, 128 GiB.** My own probes reproduced its control pattern (22 OPEN from the recorded /32 = this machine · 80 fast-RST · 5432 7s NSG-drop); KS-601 receipt 1aa008ce verified. **Held on the port-22 question rather than guessing wide** — and surfaced that demo's own NSG has SSH open to 0.0.0.0/0 (→ Kam's queue). **Deviated TIGHTER than my ruling, correctly:** pre-built the NSG and attached at create, killing the no-NSG window my "--nsg-rule NONE then add rules" would have opened. **Corrected my price at source with a control on the read** (zonal ⇒ Standard IP: 77.05 not 76.03 — my Basic-rate error, inside Kam's "77 is fine"). Two Stage-A plan defects found only by execution (the x64 `Ubuntu2404` alias cannot create an ARM64 D2ps_v6 — reviewed+merged via #707 and unrunnable as written; the zone-3 subscription restriction, its own first misread recorded as wrong). Reused the failed create's NIC/IP/vnet with a no-orphans proof. Refused to generate the SSH key before the go ("a credential before the go is the wallet mistake"). Timed port probes with in-host controls. history.md s47 backfill folded in as ruled. Second independent confirmation of the Linear `comments(last:N)` oldest-first trap. Restraint: no wallet, no DNS, no stack, demo untouched, In Progress not In Review with reasoning. |
| Secuura agent | PR review pass under a no-merge absolute (s47, KS-256/#568) | 1 | 1.00 | 1.0 | **08-19 (~37 min) — all six review items done; merge verdict NOT YET on two mechanical blockers, both measured not inferred.** Verified at source by me before this row: comment d94fc204 on KS-256 (23:24:06Z, 14.8KB, ticket still In Review), develop unmoved `74a330fc0` (my ls-remote), board 142 unchanged. Headlines: **built every service at the pushed head `6b1eff07e` — 24/25 pass, originate alone red on the exact documentUuid line Peter said was uncommitted**, so "ready to merge" became a mechanical block on his push (and it separated its own stale-dist TS2305 from his branch rather than reporting it); **the find of the session: all 16 `address` fields in the published spec carry the person literal "Demo Issuer"** — E5 *certifies* it because PERSON_FIELDS reads `address` as postal while the platform means Cardano wallet — customer-facing doc defect, copying any of the 16 guarantees rejection; E8/E9 shown to be name-list-gated (founding defects pass under a rename; honest bound stated: coverage bound, not a live leak); **refuted its OWN verify/ hypothesis and recorded it as refuted on the ticket** (real mechanism: MIN_OBSERVATIONS=3 null-verdict gap, so "37% evidence-backed" overstates); fresh seeded sweep answered Peter's 26×400 challenge (strictly-fixable 5, arguably 8, above his ≤4) and independently corroborated his 91-failure/all-mapped ack premise from a different tier+seed; **baseline-ack recommendation the right shape** — principle yes, artefact (schemathesis-baseline.json) required for a standing rule, per-PR human judgement for #568, not ruled on the ticket; also caught MY brief's api-gateway instruction being wrong (restart-not-rebuild + checksum — bind-mount dead-inode trap, hit live) and the check:openapi-green≠builds trap. PII checkbox absence on the PR body flagged as blocker 2. Second PII-adjacent session in a row with zero identity/hold slips. |
| HPSM agent | readiness sprint under the slip (s27) | 1 | 1.00 | 1.0 | *

# Kam decision sitting — 2026-08-14

> ## 🔴 NEW 2026-08-19 ~11:1x — Secuura/Blockchain: the DEMO VM's SSH is open to the
> world (MEDIUM, cheap fix)
> Found by s48 while looking for a port-22 precedent for Kintsugi: `secuura02-demo-vmNSG`
> rule `default-allow-ssh` reads `dstPort=22 src=*` — **SSH on the internet-facing demo VM
> accepts connections from 0.0.0.0/0 today** (key-auth still required; this is exposure,
> not breach). Kintsugi was deliberately NOT built that way (22 scoped to a /32, recorded
> on KS-601). **Ask: authorise tightening demo's rule to the same recorded source set**
> (one `az network nsg rule update`, reversible, ~2 min) — demo-affecting config, so your
> call per never-touch-demo-unprompted. Recommendation: yes, align it with Kintsugi's
> posture once Peter's and Stuart's source IPs are on KS-601 (so nobody gets locked out).

> ## ✅ RULED 2026-08-17 20:2x (Kam, verbatim in prompt-log): CI cause CONFIRMED — "github is
> out of money. I need to discuss this with the team on Wednesday as I should not be the one
> paying for it all. continue with what you can without this on Secuura and HPSM."
> → KS-660 cause settled (org Actions spend exhausted) · resolution parked to the TEAM
> DISCUSSION WEDNESDAY 2026-08-20 (cost-sharing) · fleet works CI-independent until then;
> nothing merges against the red pipeline. Original entry below for the record.

> ## 🔴 NEW 2026-08-17 ~18:5x — Secuura/Blockchain: CI DEAD, develop RED — likely the org Actions spending limit. TWO-MINUTE CHECK (KS-660, Urgent)
> **Every `needs: build` CI job dies in 3-4s with zero steps since ~08:27Z** (build itself
> passes; short jobs without the dependency pass — so not a blanket outage). Same tree passed
> at 07:55 and failed at 08:27, proven environmental. **The likely cause is the org Actions
> spending limit (the recorded prior failure mode), which only you can see** — the project
> PAT 403s on billing and annotations. **Ask: check the org's Actions billing/spending page
>
